mapper.select:
select ifnull(sum(quantity),0) quantity, ifnull(sum(total_net_weight),0) mete, ifnull(sum(total_gross_weight),0) mete_two from tech_machine_part where bool_delete_enum = 0 and relation_type in (2, 16)
and area_id = #{areaId}

SELECT a.* FROM ( SELECT mp.id, mp.bool_status_enum, 18 relation_type, mp.structure_type, mp.name, mp.serial_number, mp.specification, mp.length, 16 productType, mp.material, mp.net_weight, mp.gross_weight, mp.drawing_number, mp.user_id, mp.net_weight * a.quantity * ampl.quantity AS total_net_weight, mp.gross_weight * a.quantity * ampl.quantity AS total_gross_weight, mp.surface_area / 1000000 surface_area, mp.surface_area * a.quantity * ampl.quantity / 1000000 AS totalSurfaceArea, (select name from sys_user where bool_delete_enum = 0 and id = mp.user_id) AS user_name, a.quantity * ampl.quantity AS quantity, ampl.remark, mp.bool_scheduling_enum, mp.bool_process, false bool_have_hole, 0 hole_number, mp.bool_send_directly FROM tech_assemble_detail AS ampl INNER JOIN tech_assemble AS mp ON ampl.assemble_id = mp.id AND mp.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN tech_artifact AS a ON ampl.artifact_id = a.id AND mp.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE ampl.artifact_id = #{artifactId} AND ampl.bool_delete_enum = 0 union all SELECT mp.id, mp.bool_status_enum, mp.relation_type, mp.structure_type, mp.name, mp.serial_number, mp.specification, mp.length, 1 productType, mp.material, mp.net_weight, mp.gross_weight, mp.drawing_number, mp.user_id, mp.net_weight * a.quantity * ampl.quantity AS total_net_weight, mp.gross_weight * a.quantity * ampl.quantity AS total_gross_weight, mp.surface_area / 1000000 surface_area, mp.surface_area * a.quantity * ampl.quantity / 1000000 AS totalSurfaceArea, (select name from sys_user where bool_delete_enum = 0 and id = mp.user_id) AS user_name, a.quantity * ampl.quantity AS quantity, ampl.remark, mp.bool_scheduling_enum, mp.bool_process, mp.bool_have_hole, mp.hole_number, mp.bool_send_directly FROM tech_artifact_machine_part_link AS ampl INNER JOIN tech_machine_part AS mp ON ampl.machine_part_id = mp.id AND mp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mp.relation_type IN (2) INNER JOIN tech_artifact AS a ON ampl.artifact_id = a.id AND mp.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE ampl.artifact_id = #{artifactId} AND ampl.bool_delete_enum = 0 ) a order by a.bool_send_directly desc, a.productType desc

SELECT sc.NAME classificationName, sc.id classificationId, ta.material material, IFNULL(sum(ta.quantity), 0) quantity, IFNULL(sum(ta.total_net_weight), 0) totalNetWeight, IFNULL(SUM(total_gross_weight), 0) totalGrossWeight FROM ( SELECT steel_id, material, SUM(quantity) quantity, SUM(total_net_weight) total_net_weight, SUM(total_gross_weight) total_gross_weight FROM tech_machine_part WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND bool_delete_enum = 0 AND relation_type IN (2, 16) GROUP BY steel_id, material ) AS ta LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classification AS sc ON ta.steel_id = sc.id AND sc.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY sc.NAME, ta.material, sc.id ORDER BY sc.name ASC

SELECT mp.id, mp.serial_number, mp.specification, mp.length, 16 productType, 18 relationType, mp.material, mp.net_weight, 0 gross_weight, mp.drawing_number, mp.user_id, mp.net_weight * ar.quantity * ampl.quantity AS total_net_weight, 0 AS total_gross_weight, mp.surface_area / 1000000 surface_area, (SELECT NAME FROM sys_user WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND id = mp.user_id) AS user_name, ar.quantity * ampl.quantity AS quantity, mp.remark, mp.bool_scheduling_enum, mp.bool_process, mp.bool_send_directly FROM tech_assemble_detail AS ampl INNER JOIN tech_assemble AS mp ON ampl.assemble_id = mp.id AND mp.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN tech_artifact AS ar ON ampl.artifact_id = ar.id AND ar.bool_delete_enum = 0
WHERE ampl.artifact_id = #{artifactId} AND ampl.bool_delete_enum = 0 ORDER BY mp.bool_send_directly DESC, mp.id ASC
select round(sum((ifnull(a.quantity, 0) * ifnull(a.net_weight, 0)) / 1000), 2) as ton from tech_machine_part a where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.project_id = #{projectId}
